| cost = 6
| power = 2000
| engtext = {{Shield Trigger|s}}

■ [[When you put]] this [[creature]] into the [[battle zone]], you may [[choose]] a [[creature]] in the [[battle zone]] and return it to its [[owner]]'s [[hand]].
| jptext = {{Icon|ST}} S・トリガー（このクリーチャーをシールドゾーンから手札に加える時、コストを支払わずにすぐ召喚してもよい） 

■ このクリーチャーをバトルゾーンに出した時、バトルゾーンにあるクリーチャーを1体選び、持ち主の手札に戻してもよい。  
| flavor = "Wave goodbye!" ([[DM-05]]) 
| flavor1 = リキッド・ピープルはあきらめない。ひらめきを信じて。Liquid People never give up. They believe in their inspirations. ([[DMC-24]])
| flavor2 = 彼が起こす波は、まさにビッグウェイブという名の奇跡だ! The wave he creates is truly a miracle, known as the Big Wave! ([[DMC-35]])
| flavor3 = 一昨日から出直しな! "Start over from the day before yesterday!" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMC-37]], [[DMPCD-01]])
| flavor4 = ツイてるね!乗ってるね! "You're lucky! You're on a roll!" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMC-38]])
| flavor5 = 俺の闇眼に見えぬものなどありはしない! "There is nothing that cannot be seen by my dark eye!" -[[Vavelle]] ([[DMC-48]])
| flavor6 = ヒャッホウ!この波で一発逆転してやるぜ! "Yeehaw! I'm gonna turn things around with this wave!" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMC-50]])
| flavor7 = 波がきてるね～、俺♪ "The wave is coming, right? I'm ready!" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMC-63]])
| flavor8 = イロイロ乗っちゃってるね～、オレ。"I'm on all sorts of things, huh?!" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMD-02]])
| flavor9 = ヒャッホゥ! "Woohoo!" ([[DMX-03]])
| flavor10 = あいつら話しかけても、俺らの知らない言葉でしゃべりやがるんだよな…。 "They talk to us in a language we don't even know, right...?" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMD-06]])
| flavor11 = おいおい、ここにきて波に乗らないって、お前ノリ悪いな! "Hey, hey, you're not riding the wave here? You're really not feeling it!" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMX-10]])
| flavor12 = 世界は激動の波にのまれてる!そんな時こそ、波に乗っちゃうぜ、オレはね! "The world is being swallowed by a tumultuous wave! It's in times like this that I'll ride the wave!" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMD-08]])
| flavor13 = オラクルの支配は世界を平和にしたが、同時に退屈ももたらした。The rule of the [[Oracle]] brought peace to the world, but at the same time, it also brought boredom. ([[DMD-09]])
| flavor14 = 乗るしかないでしょ、この自由という名のビッグウェーブに! "You've got no choice but to ride this big wave called freedom!" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMD-11]])
| flavor15 = 難しい話はさておき、とにかくお前はひっこんでな! "Putting aside the complicated stuff, just stay out of it for now!" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMD-14]])
| flavor16 = 動きの鈍い火文明のドラゴンが、我々の速攻殺法に対抗できるかな?　"Do you think the slow-moving fire civilization dragons can counter our swift killing method?" ─'''Aqua Surfer''' ([[DMD-17]])
| flavor17 = 以前の僕はひ弱で水文明クリーチャーなのに泳ぎも苦手、女の子や火文明のヤツらにバカにされる毎日でした。しかしある日、大宇宙から凄いものが届いたのです! I used to be a weak creature in the Water Civilization and I wasn't any good swimming, so every day I was ridiculed by girls and Fire Civilization guys . But one day, something amazing arrived from the universe! ([[DMX-12]], b70)
| flavor18 = このサーフボードと出会ってスグに直感しました、コイツは僕が今まで使ってきた浮き輪とはパワーが違う。もうただの高コスト低パワークリーチャーとは呼ばせない! When I got this surfboard, I had an intuition about it, and knew it had a different power than the floats I had tried so far! Don't just consider me a high-cost, low-power creature! ([[DMX-12]], b71)
| flavor19 = 大宇宙のパワーを持った神秘のサーフボードと一緒なら1日たった24時間のトレーニングで僕の様にシールドトリガー能力が身に付きます。 With a mysterious surfboard that has a universal power, you can acquire the shield trigger ability just like me in only 24 hours of training each day. ([[DMX-12]], b72)
| flavor20 = 今では女の子にモテモテ、強大な相手も一撃で退散。水文明を代表するクリーチャーになれました!神秘のサーフボードには本当に感謝しています!（水文明男性／1700歳） Nowadays, I'm popular with the girls and powerful opponents are dismissed in a single blow. I became a representative creature of the Water Civilization. I really appreciate the mysterious surfboard! (Water Civilization male / 1700 years old) ([[DMX-12]], b73)
| flavor21 = デッキにトリガーは8枚以上入れよう!そうすれば、シールド・トリガー率がぐっとアップするぞ! "Let's put more than 8 triggers in the deck! If you do that, the shield trigger rate will skyrocket!" ([[DMX-20]])
| flavor22 = Your beloved next-door neighbor, Aqua-surfer!! ([[DMX-22]])
| flavor23 = Fantastic! Fooooooooooooooow!  ([[DMX-24]])
| flavor24 = くらえ、黄昏地獄オフ・ザ・リップ! "Take this, Tasogate Hell Off the Rip!"　―[[Mimi Tasogare]] (P23/Y9)
| flavor25 = 派手にぶちかませ! "Smash it with flair!" ～MITSUAKI～ (P59/Y9)
| flavor26 = 夢をつかみとれ! "Grab hold of your dream!" ～KYOHEI～ (P60/Y9)
| flavor27 = デュエマーランド、そこは夢と希望の国!!楽しすぎて波にノッちゃうぜ!! "Duema Land, the land of dreams and hope!! It's so fun, you'll be riding the wave!!" (P21/Y14)
